bodies: State Driver Licensing Agencies (AAMVA model curriculum)
Federal Motor Carrier Safety Administration (registered training providers)
Towing and Recovery Association of America
NCBFAA Educational Institute with the National Association of Foreign-Trade Zones
FIATA with the NCBFAA Educational Institute

exams.name: ATSSA Flagger Instructor Certification
exams.blurb: Train-the-trainer certification qualifying holders to teach flagging procedures and work-zone signalling under the MUTCD to road crews.

exams.name: ATSSA Traffic Control Supervisor Certification
exams.blurb: Certification for personnel who plan, inspect and supervise temporary traffic control on highway work zones under MUTCD Part 6.

exams.name: ATSSA Traffic Control Technician Certification
exams.blurb: Entry-level work-zone credential covering device placement, taper lengths, channelising devices and flagging under federal MUTCD standards.

exams.name: CDL Air Brakes Knowledge Test
exams.body: State Driver Licensing Agencies (AAMVA model curriculum)
exams.blurb: Knowledge test on air brake components, inspection and emergency stopping required to remove the L restriction from a commercial licence.

exams.name: CDL Basic Vehicle Control Skills Test
exams.body: State Driver Licensing Agencies (AAMVA model curriculum)
exams.blurb: Closed-course examination of straight-line backing, offset backing, parallel parking and alley docking manoeuvres for commercial vehicles.

exams.name: CDL Combination Vehicles Knowledge Test
exams.body: State Driver Licensing Agencies (AAMVA model curriculum)
exams.blurb: Class A knowledge test covering coupling and uncoupling, trailer air lines, rollover prevention and combination vehicle inspection.

exams.name: CDL Doubles and Triples Endorsement Knowledge Test
exams.body: State Driver Licensing Agencies (AAMVA model curriculum)
exams.blurb: Endorsement test on pulling multiple trailers, converter dollies, crack-the-whip effects and coupling sequence for double and triple combinations.

exams.name: CDL General Knowledge Test
exams.body: State Driver Licensing Agencies (AAMVA model curriculum)
exams.blurb: Core written test taken by every commercial driver applicant, covering vehicle inspection, safe operating procedures, cargo and hours of service.

exams.name: CDL Hazardous Materials Endorsement Knowledge Test
exams.body: State Driver Licensing Agencies (AAMVA model curriculum)
exams.blurb: Endorsement test on placarding, shipping papers, loading rules and emergency response for drivers hauling regulated hazardous materials.

exams.name: CDL On-Road Driving Skills Test
exams.body: State Driver Licensing Agencies (AAMVA model curriculum)
exams.blurb: Examiner-scored drive covering turns, intersections, railway crossings, lane changes and hill operation in a representative commercial vehicle.

exams.name: CDL Passenger Endorsement Knowledge Test
exams.body: State Driver Licensing Agencies (AAMVA model curriculum)
exams.blurb: Knowledge test on passenger loading, standee lines, emergency exits and bus inspection required to carry 16 or more people.

exams.name: CDL Pre-Trip Vehicle Inspection Test
exams.body: State Driver Licensing Agencies (AAMVA model curriculum)
exams.blurb: Verbal walk-around examination in which the applicant identifies and explains inspection points on engine, brakes, coupling and trailer systems.

exams.name: CDL School Bus Endorsement Knowledge Test
exams.body: State Driver Licensing Agencies (AAMVA model curriculum)
exams.blurb: Endorsement test on danger zones, student loading and unloading, railway crossings and evacuation procedures for school bus drivers.

exams.name: CDL Tank Vehicle Endorsement Knowledge Test
exams.body: State Driver Licensing Agencies (AAMVA model curriculum)
exams.blurb: Endorsement test covering liquid surge, baffled and unbaffled tanks, outage and high centre of gravity handling for tank vehicles.

exams.name: Certified Automotive Fleet Manager
exams.blurb: Fleet management credential earned by passing eight discipline examinations spanning asset, financial, information, maintenance and risk management.

exams.name: Certified Automotive Fleet Specialist
exams.blurb: Intermediate fleet credential awarded after completing four of the eight CAFM discipline examinations covering core fleet operations topics.

exams.name: Entry-Level Driver Training Class A CDL Theory Assessment
exams.body: Federal Motor Carrier Safety Administration (registered training providers)
exams.blurb: Federally mandated theory curriculum and 80 percent assessment that first-time Class A applicants must complete before taking the CDL skills test.

exams.name: Entry-Level Driver Training Class B CDL Theory Assessment
exams.body: Federal Motor Carrier Safety Administration (registered training providers)
exams.blurb: Required theory instruction and assessment covering vehicle systems, safe operating procedures and non-driving activities for Class B applicants.

exams.name: Entry-Level Driver Training Class B to Class A Upgrade Theory Assessment
exams.body: Federal Motor Carrier Safety Administration (registered training providers)
exams.blurb: Shortened federal theory curriculum for existing Class B holders upgrading to Class A, focused on combination vehicles and coupling.

exams.name: Entry-Level Driver Training Hazardous Materials Endorsement Theory Assessment
exams.body: Federal Motor Carrier Safety Administration (registered training providers)
exams.blurb: Theory-only federal training requirement covering hazmat regulations and loading rules before a driver may take the H endorsement test.

exams.name: Entry-Level Driver Training Passenger Endorsement Theory Assessment
exams.body: Federal Motor Carrier Safety Administration (registered training providers)
exams.blurb: Federal theory and behind-the-wheel curriculum required before a driver may obtain a passenger endorsement on a commercial licence.

exams.name: Entry-Level Driver Training School Bus Endorsement Theory Assessment
exams.body: Federal Motor Carrier Safety Administration (registered training providers)
exams.blurb: Federally required theory and range training on student management, loading zones and evacuation before the school bus endorsement test.

exams.name: IMSA Roadway Lighting Technician Certification
exams.blurb: Certification for technicians installing and maintaining street and highway lighting circuits, luminaires, poles and photoelectric controls.

exams.name: IMSA Traffic Signal Technician Certification
exams.blurb: Tiered certification covering traffic signal construction, controllers, detection, conflict monitors and field maintenance of intersection equipment.

exams.name: IMSA Work Zone Traffic Control Safety Certification
exams.blurb: Certification on temporary traffic control zones, signing, channelising devices and flagger safety for municipal and utility road crews.

exams.name: Motorcycle Safety Foundation Advanced RiderCourse
exams.blurb: One-day course for licensed riders on cornering, braking drills, risk management and machine control using the rider own motorcycle.

exams.name: Motorcycle Safety Foundation Basic RiderCourse
exams.blurb: Entry-level rider training with classroom and range instruction; completion often waives the state motorcycle skills test for endorsement.

exams.name: Motorcycle Safety Foundation RiderCoach Preparation Course
exams.blurb: Instructor certification course preparing candidates to teach MSF curricula, including coaching technique, range management and evaluation.

exams.name: NAPT Certified Director of Pupil Transportation
exams.blurb: Credential for school transportation directors covering routing, fleet maintenance, special-needs transport, budgeting and driver supervision.

exams.name: National Registry of Certified Medical Examiners Certification Test
exams.blurb: Federal test qualifying clinicians to perform commercial driver physicals and issue medical examiner certificates under FMCSA standards.

exams.name: National Safety Council Defensive Driving Course
exams.blurb: Nationally recognised driver improvement course teaching collision avoidance, space management and hazard recognition for fleet and personal drivers.

exams.name: TRAA National Driver Certification Program
exams.body: Towing and Recovery Association of America
exams.blurb: Three-level towing certification covering light-duty, medium/heavy-duty and recovery operations with written and practical evaluations.

exams.name: TSA Hazardous Materials Endorsement Threat Assessment
exams.blurb: Federal fingerprint-based background check every commercial driver must clear before a state may issue a hazardous materials endorsement.

exams.name: WreckMaster Towing and Recovery Certification
exams.blurb: Graded towing and recovery certification covering rigging, winching, load calculation and rollover recovery for light through heavy-duty operators.

exams.name: Certified Customs Specialist
exams.blurb: Open-book certification on US import regulations, entry procedures, classification, valuation and trade agreements for customs professionals.

exams.name: Certified Export Specialist
exams.blurb: Certification covering the Export Administration Regulations, ITAR, licensing, denied party screening and export documentation.

exams.name: Certified Global Business Professional
exams.blurb: Exam-based credential covering global business management, market research, supply chain management and trade finance.

exams.name: Certified Logistics Associate
exams.blurb: Foundational supply chain credential covering the logistics environment, safety, quality, teamwork and workplace computer systems.

exams.name: Certified Logistics Technician
exams.blurb: Mid-level warehouse credential on receiving, storage, order processing, packaging, inventory control, dispatch and tracking operations.

exams.name: Certified Transportation Broker
exams.blurb: Examination for freight brokers covering broker-carrier agreements, liability, claims, credit management and federal brokerage regulation.

exams.name: Certified Transportation Professional
exams.blurb: Four-part examination for private fleet managers spanning equipment, operations, finance and human resource management.

exams.name: Certified Zone Specialist
exams.body: NCBFAA Educational Institute with the National Association of Foreign-Trade Zones
exams.blurb: Certification on United States Foreign-Trade Zone operations, admission procedures, inventory control and zone compliance requirements.

exams.name: Customs Broker License Examination
exams.blurb: Federal 80-question open-book examination held twice a year that applicants must pass to become a licensed customs broker.

exams.name: Export Compliance Professional Certification
exams.blurb: Specialist certification in EAR or ITAR export controls, licensing, classification and enforcement for trade compliance staff.

exams.name: FIATA Diploma in Freight Forwarding
exams.body: FIATA with the NCBFAA Educational Institute
exams.blurb: Internationally recognised freight forwarding diploma covering multimodal transport, documentation, insurance and incoterms.

exams.name: IATA Air Cargo Security Awareness Training
exams.blurb: Training on supply chain security, known consignor rules, screening methods and threat recognition for air cargo handling staff.

exams.name: IATA Airport Operations Fundamentals
exams.blurb: Course and assessment covering airside operations, ground handling, turnaround coordination, capacity planning and airport safety management.

exams.name: IATA Cargo Introductory Course
exams.blurb: Foundation air cargo qualification covering air waybills, rating, cargo acceptance, handling procedures and IATA regulations.

exams.name: Master Customs Specialist
exams.blurb: Advanced designation for CCS holders covering partner government agency requirements, enforcement actions and complex entry issues.

exams.name: Master Export Specialist
exams.blurb: Advanced export designation building on the CES and covering sanctions, licensing strategy and export enforcement in depth.

exams.name: NATMI Certified Director of Maintenance
exams.blurb: Credential for fleet maintenance executives covering preventive maintenance programmes, shop management, budgeting and DOT compliance.

exams.name: NATMI Certified Director of Safety
exams.blurb: Certification for motor carrier safety directors covering FMCSA compliance, driver qualification files, accident investigation and CSA scores.

exams.name: NATMI Certified Safety Supervisor
exams.blurb: Entry-level trucking safety credential covering hours of service, drug and alcohol testing, cargo securement and driver coaching.

exams.name: NATMI Certified Supervisor of Maintenance
exams.blurb: Supervisory credential covering shop workflow, technician management, warranty recovery and vehicle inspection requirements.

exams.name: FRA Blue Signal Protection Training
exams.blurb: Training under 49 CFR Part 218 on blue signal display and removal protecting workers servicing rolling equipment.

exams.name: FRA Conductor Certification
exams.blurb: Federally required certification of freight and passenger conductors covering rules knowledge, skills testing and monitoring under Part 242.

exams.name: FRA Locomotive Engineer Certification
exams.blurb: Certification required to operate a locomotive, involving written examination, skills performance testing and periodic operational monitoring.

exams.name: FRA Part 243 Safety-Related Railroad Employee Training
exams.blurb: Federal rule requiring railroads and contractors to qualify safety-related employees through approved training programmes and testing.

exams.name: FRA Roadway Worker Protection Training
exams.blurb: Annual training under Part 214 on on-track safety, working limits, train approach warning and job briefings for roadway workers.

exams.name: FRA Track Inspector Qualification
exams.blurb: Qualification under the Track Safety Standards allowing an individual to inspect track, classify defects and authorise remedial action.

exams.name: National Transit Institute Roadway Worker Protection Training
exams.blurb: Rail transit training on right-of-way access, protection methods and hazard recognition for wayside workers and contractors.

exams.name: Public Transportation Safety Certification Training Program
exams.blurb: Federally mandated curriculum for state safety oversight staff and rail transit agency personnel with safety oversight responsibilities.

exams.name: Roadway Worker in Charge Qualification
exams.blurb: Qualification allowing a worker to establish and control on-track working limits and conduct job briefings for a roadway work group.

exams.name: Transit Safety and Security Program Certificate
exams.blurb: USDOT certificate programme for transit safety professionals covering system safety, security planning, emergency management and audits.
